description: Add Terms link to navigation bar for legal accessibility

userStories.title: Add Terms link to Navbar
userStories.description: As a user, I want to access the Terms page via the main navigation bar so that I can read the terms of service.
acceptanceCriteria: Locate the navigation container in src/components/Navbar.jsx
Add a Link component pointing to '/terms' with the text 'Terms'
Ensure the new link uses the same CSS classes/styles as existing navbar links
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
